nodes.description: Storage slot 0x360894a13ba1a3210667c828492db98dca3e2076cc3735a920a3ca505d382bbc holding the implementation (logic) address read/written via assembly sload/sstore.

TransparentProxy constructor, sets initial implementation (with optional init data) and initial admin.
External admin-only function that swaps the implementation address and optionally delegatecalls init data.
External admin-only view returning the current admin address via _admin().
External admin-only function that checks the disabled lock flag before writing a new admin.
External admin-only function that permanently locks admin transfer by writing max uint to the disabled slot.
Modifier that compares msg.sender with the stored admin and routes non-admins to _fallback.

ifAdmin restricts changeImplementation to the stored admin.
ifAdmin restricts proxyAdmin to the stored admin.
ifAdmin restricts changeProxyAdmin to the stored admin.
ifAdmin restricts disableChangeProxyAdmin to the stored admin.
For non-admin callers ifAdmin falls through to _fallback, giving untrusted callers the delegatecall execution path.
receive() forwards incoming value transfers to _fallback.
fallback() forwards unmatched calldata to _fallback.
_fallback loads the implementation address from the implementation slot and uses it as the delegatecall target.
